newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: KEPCO awards 222,000/T Aug-Sept fuel oil to Vitol.
newsitem.headline: KEPCO awards 222,000/T Aug-Sept fuel oil to Vitol.

text.p: The Korean Electric Power Company (KEPCO) has awarded to Vitol Singapore a tender to buy three 74,000-tonne cargoes of fuel oil at $123.93 and $121.95 per tonne, a company source said on Thursday.
The first two 0.3-percent, 540-cst cargoes were bought at $123.93 per tonne and the third at $121.95 per tonne, all on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) Ulsan basis, the source said.
The first cargo will be for August 13-17 delivery, the second for August 28 to September 1 and the last for September 18-22 to the port of Ulsan, he said.
In its last fuel oil purchase, KEPCO bought two 70,000-tonne cargoes at $126.70 and $133.00 per tonne, respectively, also on a c-and-f Ulsan basis .
